data.name: Show It 2 Me
data.detailed_description:
Show It 2 Me is an interactive VR music video created using Tilt Brush's audio reactive brushes featuring Night Club's single, “Show It 2 Me.” Show It 2 Me first debuted at SXSW’s Virtual Cinema 2017. It features art created by Titmouse president and owner Chris Prynoski and Titmouse Creative Director Antonio Canobbio using the audio reactive brushes in Tilt Brush - Google’s virtual reality app.

The viewer will go on a trippy, visual ride featuring demonic cars, pulsating brains, and disembodied tongue-mouths. Named after the song by Night Club, an electronic music duo from Los Angeles that features Emily Kavanaugh and Mark Brooks, Show it 2 Me is co-directed by Mark Brooks and Dylan Carter.

reviews.review:
Although the thunder was stolen by Viacom, Smash Party VR was the first entry by Titmouse into the world of virtual reality. As the name indicates, it was a "wreck stuff" simulator, and while Show It 2 Me is a different breed of game entirely, its bright neon colors, retrowave theme, and 80's vaporwave aesthetic conjure up some great memories of Titmouse's debut VR release.

Simply put, Show It 2 Me is an interactive synthwave music video filled with thrilling animations made from neon pinks, blues, and greens. More accurately, it's like being on an LSD trip while attending a 1980's themed rave. The music is thumping and catchy, providing an outstanding chorus hook that'll stay engrained in your mind even after the short experience is over. Interactivity comes in to play in a small, but fun, manner, where you're able to catch and throw daggers, shift gears during certain parts involving a car, and you're also able to draw whatever you want with both hands; the left hand producing neon pink lines, and the right creating electric blue lines.

Even though the event lasts about five minutes, Show It 2 Me is worth playing through at least two times as you're guaranteed to miss many parts of the action while you're looking around. Whether it's the female in the car with you whose head changes shape, the surrounding buildings, neon grids, or entry portals as you're being moved from one part of the song to the next. Show It 2 Me is great for experienced VR owners, as well as newcomers to the platform, and it showcases what virtual reality is all about; amazing worlds filled with things that we would never see otherwise.

[h1]Rating: [b]5.0/5.0[/b] - An astonishing achievement, this game must be played.[/h1]
